entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this, you know?
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I'd be happy to look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-886-103-5B. It's the jersey I bought. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this has just really let me down.
Okay, I see the order here for the Pro-Line jersey. I understand you're upset, but to make sure I can help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with it?

It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but it's just so incredibly tight I can barely zip it up. I was really looking forward to wearing it on my club ride this weekend. Now I can't, and I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.
I see. So it's a sizing issue, and you're looking to either return it or maybe do an exchange for a different size?
Yes, I think an exchange would be okay if you have the large, but a return would be better. I'm just feeling pretty down about the whole thing.

I completely understand the frustration when something doesn't fit right. Let me just check our policy for you... Okay, I'm looking at your delivery date, which was about 24 days ago. According to our system, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely get that return processed for you.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. You've really turned my day around.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just package the jersey back up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for making this so easy.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
